LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_Unavailable: Suiyin cannot be contacted right now
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_Title: The wall and the outstretched hand
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_Arrival: Suiyin has sent a private letter. She would like you to look at two receipts concerning the same shipment of grain.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_Conditions: Agree to receive two copies. No supplies are required at present.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_Accepted: You have agreed to receive the two copies. They have not arrived yet.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_AcceptedReply: Thank you. I'll have the messenger bring the copies over.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_DeclinedReply: All right. I'll put them away for now.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_ReplyFailed: This letter cannot be answered right now.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_Pending: Suiyin is waiting for your reply.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E3Title: The hand held out to me
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E1_01: "I was so innocent as a child..."
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E1_03: "Oh, my little darling. Shall we go and play in the imperial garden?"
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E1_06: "That's a butterfly. A little insect that flies. Its wings are pretty, aren't they?"
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E1_09: "Oh, my little darling, of course there are."
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E1_10: "Then can all ratkin play like this?"
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E1_15: "Back then, I didn't yet know I was living in a lie..."
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E2_01: Suiyin climbs a staircase of carefully arranged chairs to scale the palace wall.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E2_03: She leaps over the palace wall and lands in the street outside.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E2_04: The wealthy district is quiet at night.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E2_06: There were still lights on behind the doors. I heard laughter and glasses clinking together. I thought this place was much like the palace.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E2_07: Further along, there was almost no light at all, and I thought I could smell something awful.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E2_08: A ratkin pulling a cart passed me. He glanced at me without slowing down.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E2_10: "..." The ratkin gave no answer. He simply trudged on, numb.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E2_12: Suiyin reaches toward the people fighting over food, but they push her aside.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E2_13: "Why don't they have anything to eat? They're right outside the wall. Do you know about them?"
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E2_14: "Why have you run off to play again!"
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E2_15: "Do not leave the palace. Everything in the world outside is false."
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E2_17: They shut the door. I sat there thinking of that empty pot outside. Why did some people not have enough to eat? I kept wondering.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E3_01: The second time I went out, I had so many questions in mind. I didn't know how to say them, even after turning them over for so long.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E3_03: Ratkin prayed in the church every day. I had prayed too. But who were the ratkin outside the wall supposed to ask for help?
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E3_04: A hand blocks Suiyin's path. An unlit cigarette. A smiley face on a purple coat.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E3_05: "Come on. Let's see what god (the archotech) will do."
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E3_06: Suiyin looks up at the man and slowly reaches her right hand toward his palm.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E4_01: I've written and torn it up again. I've already ruined several sheets of paper.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E4_02: There are two receipts in the palace for the same shipment of grain. One says it has already arrived. The other says it hasn't been sent yet. I asked the person who keeps them, and he told me to ask someone else.
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E4_03: I daren't take the originals out again, so I made two copies. Would you look at them for me?
LanguageData.RHAH_Kingdom_E4_04: All I want to know right now is which one is wrong.\n—Suiyin
